prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left at an intersection. The patient reported immediate pain, swelling, and difficulty bearing weight on the right knee. Physical examination revealed moderate effusion, tenderness along the medial joint line, and restricted range of motion with pain on flexion beyond 90 degrees. Ligamentous testing showed no gross instability, and imaging was consistent with a soft tissue contusion without fracture. The patient was treated with a structured course of physical therapy, consisting of 15 supervised visits focused on quadriceps strengthening, gait training, and progressive range-of-motion exercises, along with home exercise instruction and activity modification. Pain was managed with over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medication and ice. Over the course of treatment, the patient demonstrated steady improvement in swelling, pain scores, and functional mobility. At discharge, the patient was ambulating without an assistive device, had near-full knee range of motion, and reported returning to most daily activities with occasional mild discomfort. Continued home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
